Module: include/Record.h (and src/Record.cpp)
- Type: struct Record
  - Public fields: std::string id; std::string name; std::string email; std::uint64_t revision; std::uint64_t updated_at.
  - Constructor: Record(std::string id, std::string name, std::string email, std::uint64_t revision, std::uint64_t updated_at);
    Semantics: initializes all fields exactly as provided; no default constructor provided.
  - bool operator==(const Record& other) const;
    Semantics: returns true iff all five fields are equal by value.
  - Includes: <cstdint>, <string>.

Module: include/ManualClock.h (and src/ManualClock.cpp)
- Type: class ManualClock
  - explicit ManualClock(std::uint64_t initial);
    Semantics: initializes internal counter to 'initial'. No wall-clock usage. Declared only in header; defined only in src/ManualClock.cpp.
  - std::uint64_t now() const noexcept;
    Semantics: returns current counter value.
  - void advance(std::uint64_t delta) noexcept;
    Semantics: increments internal counter by 'delta'. No overflow checks required by contract; caller responsibility.
  - Includes: <cstdint>.

Module: include/Repository.h (and src/Repository.cpp)
- Type: class Repository (concrete in-memory repository)
  - Private: std::map<std::string, Record> records_;
  - bool insert(const Record& rec);
    Return: true if id was absent and rec inserted; false if id already exists (no mutation).
  - std::optional<Record> find(const std::string& id) const;
    Return: a copy of the Record if present; std::nullopt otherwise.
  - bool replace(const Record& rec);
    Return: true if an existing record with same id was present and replaced; false if absent (no insertion).
  - bool erase(const std::string& id);
    Return: true if an element was erased; false if nothing erased.
  - std::vector<Record> list() const;
    Return: vector of all records in deterministic std::map key order (lexicographic by id).
  - Includes: <map>, <optional>, <string>, <vector>, and "Record.h".

Module: include/CrudService.h (and src/CrudService.cpp)
- Type: class CrudService
  - Private refs: Repository& repository_; ManualClock& clock_.
  - CrudService(Repository& repository, ManualClock& clock);
    Semantics: stores references; no ownership; no null allowed (references).
  - Record create(const std::string& id, const std::string& name, const std::string& email);
    Validation: throws std::invalid_argument if id or name is blank (empty or all spaces handled by caller; at minimum empty disallowed) or if email does not contain exactly one '@' not at the first or last character.
    Duplicate: throws std::runtime_error if insert fails due to existing id.
    State: constructs Record{id, name, email, revision=1, updated_at=clock_.now()} and inserts via repository_. Returns the stored Record.
  - std::optional<Record> get(const std::string& id) const;
    Semantics: returns repository_.find(id).
  - Record update(const std::string& id, const std::string& name, const std::string& email);
    Validation: same as create for name/email; id must be non-blank.
    Absent: throws std::runtime_error if target id does not exist.
    State: reads existing record, preserves id, increments revision by one (prev.revision + 1), sets updated_at to clock_.now(), and replaces via repository_. Returns the new record.
  - bool remove(const std::string& id);
    Semantics: returns repository_.erase(id).
  - std::vector<Record> list() const;
    Semantics: returns repository_.list(); deterministic order by id.
  - Includes: <optional>, <string>, <vector>, "ManualClock.h", "Record.h", and "Repository.h".

Module: src/Main.cpp
- Runtime entry: constructs Repository repo; ManualClock clock(100); CrudService service(repo, clock); creates Record with id "1"; prints at most one concise value; returns 0. No loops, no wall clock.

Allowed include direction:
- Headers are self-contained and include only what they use.
- CrudService.h may include ManualClock.h, Record.h, Repository.h.
- Repository.h includes Record.h.
- Tests include only headers from include/ by basename in code (e.g., "CrudService.h").
- Sources include their corresponding headers by basename only; no transitive reliance on standard headers.

Exceptions and validation rules:
- std::invalid_argument for invalid inputs: blank id/name or malformed email (must contain exactly one '@' not at edges).
- std::runtime_error for duplicate create or absent update.
- ManualClock operations are noexcept and deterministic.

Deterministic behaviors:
- ManualClock is the sole time source; now() used for updated_at in create/update.
- Repository list() order is deterministic by std::map key.

Notes:
- Constructor declarations appear only in headers; definitions only in matching .cpp files.
- No extra files, interfaces, or namespaces are allowed.
